_help: Pipeline switches. Claude reads this at the start of every run.
_youtube_upload: manual = you upload the YouTube files yourself (until the API audit passes); api = GitHub Actions uploads. verify-youtube switches this to manual by itself if YouTube locks the uploads
_dry_runs_left: runs that make everything but publish nothing; counts down to 0
_ab_test: off = one thumbnail, one title (Krishna, 11 Nov 2026). native = 3 title+thumbnail pairs for Test & Compare
_publish: on_finish, or a fixed IST time like 18:00 (needs youtube_upload = api)
_release_plan: Krishna, 21 Nov 2026: a main video every 2nd day and exactly one Short or Reel every day (Short the day after its main, Reel the day after that, i.e. on the next main's day). lead_minutes = how far ahead the main must be when booked. scripts/release_times.py <slug> gives the days and times.
_time_test: Krishna, 21 Nov 2026: no fixed 'best time' guesses. Every post goes out at a random minute inside one of these IST windows (7 AM to midnight), separately for YouTube main, YouTube Shorts and Instagram, spread evenly until each window has min_tests measured posts; then exploit_share of posts use the best window and the rest keep testing. Score = views at score_at_hours vs the track's typical. Calendar + data + daily report (time_test.md) live on branch data_branch; scripts/time_test.py.
_thumbnail_rules: Read before Stage 5 / A6. Overrides the skill: no KR in thumbnails, thumbnail text = the video title.
_instagram_hashtags: Max hashtags per Instagram caption (Instagram limit; Krishna 14 Nov 2026). Put as many natural search keywords as fit in the caption text instead.
